title: Reflect
wikitext:
'''Reflect''' is a mechanic that causes an effect to act on its source in addition to its target. While [[damage]] is the effect most commonly reflected, [[curses]] and [[ailment]]s can be reflected too.

==Mechanics of damage reflection==
When an attacker [[hit]]s a defender that reflects damage, a percentage of the [[damage taken]] by the defender (or a flat amount of damage, also known as "thorns") hits the attacker. When the damage is dealt by a [[proxy]] or [[minion]], it will reflect back to that proxy or minion rather than the player. [[Damage over time]] cannot hit, so it cannot be reflected (but hits that apply damage over time debuffs or damaging [[ailment]]s can still reflect the hit damage).

The amount of damage reflected is based on [[damage taken]] by the defender after [[Receiving damage|mitigation]], not their [[loss]] of resources (e.g. [[life]]/[[energy shield]]).<ref name="ReflectDamageTaken"/><ref name="ReflectAfterMitigation"/> For this reason, overkill damage and damage dealt to monsters that cannot die is reflected in full.
 
The [[damage source]] of the reflected damage matches the hit that is being reflected, and can be mitigated through corresponding mechanics:

* If the reflected damage was [[attack]] damage, it can be mitigated by attack [[block]]<ref name="ReflectBlocked /> and [[evasion]].
* If the reflected damage was [[spell]] damage, it can be mitigated by spell [[block]], [[spell suppression]] and [[spell dodge]]. 

Methods of mitigation that depend on [[damage type]] ([[resistance]]s, [[armour]]) apply as normal. Mitigation that applies to all damage types like {{stl|Fortification}} always apply.

There are currently no sources of damage reflection that reflect [[chaos]] damage based on the damage of a hit, making it unique compared to physical or elemental damage. Reflected chaos damage ''can'' exist through [[damage taken as]] chaos, or mechanics such as the {{c|mod|Summons Voodoo Doll}} [[monster modifier]]. 

[[Explosion]]s cannot be reflected. [[Secondary damage]] can be reflected, though non-explosion secondary damage is rare outside {{il|Herald of Thunder}}. 

===Reflect damage scaling===
Reflected damage cannot be scaled by offensive modifiers, except modifiers specific for reflected damage, such as {{c|mod|Impale Damage dealt to Enemies Impaled by you Overwhelms #% Physical Damage Reduction}}, [[Lord of Steel]]'s {{c|mod|#% increased Reflected Damage}}, or the {{c|mod|Reflected Damage Penetrates #% of Enemy Fire Resistance}} formerly found on {{il|Molten Shell}}'s [[alternate gem quality]]. 

However, stats that interact with damage avoidance mechanics (such as [[accuracy]]) do impact the reflected damage.<ref name="ReflectMods"/> The player's accuracy rating/chance to hit will be used against the player's [[evasion]] for reflected attack damage.<ref name="ReflectAccuracy"/>
 
===On hit/when hit & Gem interactions===
Although reflected damage [[hit]]s, it cannot trigger on/when hit effects<ref name="ReflectNoOnHit"/>, cause [[ailment]]s<ref name="ReflectNoAilments"/>, [[stun]]<ref name="ReflectNoStun"/>, deal a critical strike, or be reflected again. However, it can contribute damage to {{il|Cast when Damage Taken Support}}. 
 
===Interaction with leech===
[[Leech]] is processed before reflect damage.<ref name="ReflectOrder"/> Therefore the order of operations is:
:Hit a target -> Leech -> Receive reflected damage
Because of this, instant leech is unable to recover the life lost from reflect until the next hit.
 
===Reflect mitigation===
Reflected damage can be mitigated normally, as well as by reflect-specific stats.

* {{c|mod|(#% of) Damage cannot be Reflected}} prevents the reflection of (a portion of) your damage. 

* {{c|mod|Cannot take Reflected Physical/Elemental Damage}} prevents reflected damage of specific types, even when damage is [[damage taken as|taken as another type]]. For example, {{c|mod|Cannot take Reflected Physical Damage}} prevents reflected physical damage before it can be taken as fire damage (e.g. {{il|Cloak of Flame}}), ''and'' it prevents reflected fire damage taken as physical damage (e.g. {{il|The Rat Cage}}).

* The legacy {{c|mod|#% reduced Reflected Damage taken}} is a conditional modifier to [[damage taken]]. Bear in mind: 
** Reductions are additive with other increased/reduced [[damage taken]] modifiers, meaning debuffs like {{stl|Shock}}, {{stl|Vulnerability}} and {{stl|Marked for Death}}, or stats like {{psl|Aspect of Carnage}}, will cause the player to require more than {{c|mod|100% reduced Reflected Damage taken}} for a complete reduction. 
** [[Damage taken as]] modifiers apply ''before'' damage taken modifiers; {{c|mod|#% reduced Reflected Physical Damage taken}} will not affect reflected physical damage taken as fire. 

* The legacy {{il|Awakened Elemental Damage with Attacks Support}} prevents reflection of the supported attack's elemental damage (at level 5 or above). 

==Skills==
The following skills have effects that deal reflected damage. For gems related to explosions, the damage of which cannot be reflected, see [[explode]]. 

===Dealing reflected damage===
{{Drop enabled gem table
|where = items.class_id="Active Skill Gem"
  AND (skill.description LIKE "%Reflect%damage%to%enem%"
    OR skill.stat_text LIKE "%Reflect%damage%to%enem%")
}}
* [[Call of Steel]] 

==Sources of reflected damage reduction==
===Item modifiers===
====Equipment====
{{Query spawnable modifiers
|where=
  mod_stats.id LIKE "%reflect_damage%"
  AND mods.domain=1
  AND mods.generation_type IN (1, 2, 28, 29)
|spawn_weights=1
|generation_type=1
|q_orderBy=mods.domain ASC, mods.generation_type ASC, mods.id ASC, mods.required_level ASC
}}

* An {{il|Essence of Insanity}} can be crafted on a ring to gain the mod {{ml|DamageCannotBeReflectedPercentEssence1|display=stat_text}}

====Jewels (legacy)====
{{Query spawnable modifiers
|where=
  mod_stats.id LIKE "%reflect_damage%"
  AND mods.domain=10
|spawn_weights=1
|generation_type=1
|q_orderBy=mods.domain ASC, mods.generation_type ASC, mods.id ASC, mods.required_level ASC
}}

{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables = item_stats
|join = item_stats._pageName=items._pageName

OR  items.stat_text LIKE "%cannot%reflect%damage%"

  passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%reflect%"

===Monster modifiers===
The {{c|mod|Summons Voodoo Doll}} [[monster modifier]] creates an effigy that deals 50% of damage taken to the player while linked. The link can be broken by moving away. Also, the effigy is invulnerable for the first 2 seconds, so killing the monster fast enough can negate it.

One of the four splits of [[Atziri, Queen of the Vaal]] holds a mirror which reflects 15% physical and elemental damage to attackers. Due to the nature of [[character]] [[damage]] scaling being much higher than that of [[monster]]s, most characters will instantly die upon taking this amount of reflected damage.

===Map modifiers===
Some [[Maps#Modifiers|map modifiers]] give Rare monsters Physical or Elemental Thorns. When the monster takes physical or elemental damage, it gains a buff that causes attackers to take a flat amount of physical or elemental damage (matching the highest damage type of the hit that triggered it). The Thorns buff lasts 5 seconds and the buff can only be gained once every 10 seconds. Thorns can only deal damage once every 0.1 seconds.

Damage dealt by Thorns scales with zone level. In red tier maps, Physical Thorns deals 800 damage and Elemental Thorns deals 1500 damage. Damage from Thorns is affected by all forms of defensive mitigation ([[Armour]], [[Evasion]], damage reduction & avoidance, etc.), as well as {{c|mod|#% reduced Reflected damage taken}}.

===Other===
Certain effects are typed as reflected damage, but are not necessarily triggered when taking damage. For example, {{il|The Retch}} deals a percentage of leeched life as reflected chaos damage from leech targets.

{{stl|Impale}} damage is dealt as reflected physical damage.

==Sources of curse reflection==
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables = item_stats
|join = item_stats._pageName=items._pageName
|where = item_stats.id LIKE "%reflect_curses%" OR item_stats.id LIKE "%curse_reflection%"
|large=1
|stat=1
|level=1}}
* {{c|mod|Curses you inflict are reflected back to you}} is a [[Searing Exarch]] eldritch altar downside.
* The {{ml|MonsterModReflectHexes}} [[monster modifier]] causes monsters to reflect Hexes 
* [[Doedre Darktongue]] has the [[modifier]] {{c|mod|Hex Reflection}}.
* [[Atziri, Queen of the Vaal]]'s primary form and her split mirror form have the {{c|mod|Hex Reflection}} [[modifier]], likely for thematic reasons due to her being depicted as holding {{il|Atziri's Reflection}}.

==Sources of other debuff reflection==
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables = item_stats
|join = item_stats._pageName=items._pageName
|where = item_stats.id LIKE "%reflected_to_self%"
|large=1
|stat=1
|level=1}}
* {{c|mod|Non-Damaging Ailments you inflict are reflected back to you}} is an [[Eater of Worlds]] eldritch altar downside.
* The {{ml|MonsterModReflectNonDamagingAilments}} [[monster modifier]] causes monsters to reflect non-damaging ailments 

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.29.0|
* Reflect Map Modifiers have been reworked, instead of causing Monsters to Reflect a percentage of Physical or Elemental Hit Damage dealt to them, they instead cause Rare Monsters to have Physical or Elemental Thorns.
* Physical Thorns activates when Hit by Physical Damage and lasts for 5 seconds. While active, it reflects a fixed amount of Physical Damage each time the monster receives a Physical Hit. Monsters cannot gain Physical Thorns more than once every 10 seconds. You can only take Physical Thorns damage once every 0.1 seconds.
* Elemental Thorns activates when Hit by Elemental Damage and lasts for 5 seconds. While active, it reflects a fixed amount of Elemental Damage each time the monster receives an Elemental Hit, dealing Damage of the highest Elemental Damage type in the received Hit. Monsters cannot gain Elemental Thorns more than once every 10 seconds. You can only take Elemental Thorns damage once every 0.1 seconds.
* In Red Tier Maps, Rare Monsters have Physical Thorns reflecting 800 Physical Damage and Elemental Thorns reflecting 1500 Elemental Damage.
* Reflected Damage from Thorns is able to be mitigated through Evasion, Block, Armour, Resistances, etc.
* Reflect Modifiers no longer appear on Corrupted Side Areas in the Campaign.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.28.0|
* All sources of reduced Reflected Damage Taken have been replaced with a percentage of Damage cannot be Reflected. Some legacy items will still have the old stats however.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.20.0|
* Fixed a bug where the Flagellant Flask modifier was triggering from some types of reflected damage (which is usually prevented from triggering hit effects).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.1.0|
* Damage reflection mods on rare monsters have been removed from the game.
}}
{{Version history table row|2.0.0|
* Damage reflection mods on rare monsters are no longer auras.
}}
{{Version history table row|1.2.0|
* Both physical and elemental damage reflection from monster auras have been reduced from 15% to 14% reflection.
}}
{{Version history table end}}
